extension.rank: rank(delta_k)= (k-1)(p-k)(p+1)/2, 1<=k<=p, zero at k=1 and k=p

extension.first_order_warning: delta_1=0, even though extension is nonsplit for p>=3. Higher-order delta_k detects it.
